d: Ash blonde hair is styled with long, straight strands framing the face and a side-parted fringe, appearing soft in texture. The eyes are a deep crimson shade with a timid, wide expression, set on a face with a youthful, adolescent maturity and a slender build. The outfit consists of a dark charcoal, textured bodice with a ruffled neckline, paired with sheer, off-white draped sleeves. Signature details include dark grey, wing-like appendages extending from the back and a small, dark mark centered on the forehead.
